name: RED DOG HIGH CARD POOL
description: Red Dog High Card Pool is a one-card Indian Poker variant. Each player is dealt one card and holds it to the forehead without looking, so opponents can see it. After a round of poker betting, the highest card among those who stayed in wins the pot; ties split the pot.

content.text: Red Dog High Card Pool is a one-card Indian Poker variant. Each player is dealt one card and holds it to the forehead without looking, so opponents can see it. After a round of poker betting, the highest card among those who stayed in wins the pot; ties split the pot.

Indian Poker has nothing to do with India; the name comes from the visual of cards held to the forehead, resembling a Native American headdress or war bonnet. The one-card version is the most basic and presumably the original form: players ante, receive one card each, hold it to the forehead without looking, then bet in a round of poker betting; highest card wins the pot. It is documented among poker variants as a US-origin party game.
One card each face down; players pick up without looking and hold to forehead so others can see the card.
